notes: Hide-and-seek is named outright in Party & Casual's recognise-from list, and the Childhood Game preset is the maze-plus-clutter build this prompt describes, so I kept it whole. The shape stays the genre's bounded continuous play space with obstacle-maze carrying the hedge maze itself — that option is what puts P6 on the route, and it is not overridable, because a maze whose corridors do not connect is a broken game rather than a cheaper one. Read 'hrass' as grass, so this is an outdoor hedge maze rather than a sealed interior, kept small and branching per the answers; dark lighting is atmosphere with no geometry, so it rides along as a lighting note rather than a pick. The answers set the round ending at all hiders found with a timer backup, which is where trigger-scoring comes from.
